property_summary: For all addresses and ids, calling balanceOf(account,id) on the correct contract reverts if and only if account == address(0); the mutant removes that revert so there exist inputs (account == address(0)) where balanceOf succeeds, violating the rule.
change_summary: Removed the require check that forbids querying balanceOf for the zero address so calling balanceOf(address(0), id) now returns 0 instead of reverting.
